content: The WikInfect Project is an initiative that provides comprehensive information on anti-infective agents, derived from FDA package inserts. It also includes treatment recommendations for infections based on organ systems and specific pathogens. These recommendations are developed using established guidelines, consensus statements, review articles, and expert opinions curated by the Infection Mission Force (IMF) team. The content provided by the WikInfect Project is not intended to replace clinical judgment but rather to complement it. Given the dynamic nature of epidemiological scenarios, it is essential to consider necessary adjustments in treatment plans and to seek infectious disease consultations when appropriate to ensure optimal patient care. If there is specific or more detailed information you would like to see included, please let us know. The IMF team welcomes your feedback and encourages you to share your comments via email.
